ui.intro_hint: Type 'help' for commands. To begin: list
help_lines: list [1-5|class]       list a series or an object class  (e.g. list 2, list keter)
read <file>            open a file            (e.g. read SCP-173, read 173)
search <word>          find articles by name or number  (e.g. search sculpture)
findings               list the findings you have established
hint                   a nudge toward the next link (costs a little contamination)
random                 open a random unread file
save / load            save or restore your game
ui.no_such_file: No such record in the archive: {x}
ui.search_none: No matches. (Locked files are not searched.)
ui.cross_bad: One of those files was not recognised. Use 'list' for codes.
ui.cross_same: You cannot cross-reference a file with itself.
ui.cross_nothing: No meaningful contradiction found between these two records.
ui.hint_ready: HINT: {a} and {b} are linked. Compare them to record the link.
ui.hint_partner: HINT: {a} is connected to {b}, which you have not read yet. Read it, then compare the two.
ui.hint_locked: HINT: {a} is connected to a file above your clearance. Read more to rank up.
ui.hint_none: HINT: you have read everything reachable. Try a search.
ui.cross_known: This link is already in your notebook:
ui.findings_none: No findings yet. Compare two files with 'cross'.

contam_state.mid: Caution: text degradation has begun. Consider SCP-999 or an amnestic.
contam_state.high: CRITICAL: you are near the threshold. At 100 the audit ends.

ui.code_usage: Usage: code <key>   (keys are hidden inside the files)
ui.code_already: You already hold Level {n} clearance or higher.
ui.code_note: Re-read files you have already opened: redacted sections are now visible.
ui.amn_warn:
WARNING: a Class-C amnestic lowers contamination by {n} points and
         erases {k} of your findings at random.
ui.amn_pointless: There is no need for that right now.
ui.amn_lost: Erased findings can be re-established by cross-referencing again.
ui.report_early: A report requires at least {m} findings. You have {n}.
ui.end_hint: Different decisions lead to different endings. Run the script again to replay.
about_lines: A SCiPNET terminal simulation. A text-based investigation game.
Play: read the records, join their contradictions together with
'cross', and find the clearance keys printed inside the documents
themselves. The more you read, the higher your cognitive contamination
climbs, and the archive text begins to corrupt. You have eleven days.
565 records / 303 findings / 6 endings / 2 languages so far.
SCP Foundation concepts belong to the collaborative SCP Wiki
(https://scpwiki.com) and are licensed CC BY-SA 3.0. All prose in this
game is original and is shared under the same licence.
To add a language, copy dil/en.json to dil/<code>.json and translate it.
ui.rest_warn:
Resting ends the working day. Cognitive contamination falls by {n} points
and one day is struck off work order 4471-B. Days cannot be recovered.
ui.rest_done: You slept. Cognitive contamination fell by {n} points.
ui.rest_last:
This is the last day on the work order. When it ends, the order closes
itself, with or without a report from you.
ui.rest_final_warning:
WARNING: resting now spends the eleventh day. Work order 4471-B closes at
the end of it and the audit is concluded administratively. If you intend
to decide anything yourself, decide it before you rest.
ui.day_generic:
Another day in the archive wing. No windows, no clocks, the same coffee.
You sit down and the index is where you left it.
ui.report_locked: {n} further options are locked at your clearance.
ui.rank_up_relief: A commendation is logged against your file. Contamination reduced by {n}.
lib_intro: This archive holds real SCP Foundation files: articles from the SCP Wiki, unedited, each with its author and source link.
Read them. When an article names another one you have read, the two are linked: compare them to record the link.
The more you read, the more the archive reads you.
ui.lib_overload: >> COGNITIVE THRESHOLD EXCEEDED. Emergency decontamination: contamination reset to 50%.
ui.lib_new_links: * {n} new link(s) between files you have read. Compare them to record the link.
ui.lib_list_hint: Add a series number (1-5) or an object class (safe, euclid, keter, thaumiel, apollyon, archon, neutralized) to see its articles.
ui.lib_list_bad: Unknown list: {x}. Use a series number (1-5) or an object class.
ui.lib_load_fail: Could not load that article (network?). Try again.
ui.lib_license: Text from the SCP Wiki, CC BY-SA 3.0, converted to plain text; nothing else changed.
ui.lib_cross_nothing: Neither article refers to the other. There is no link to record.
ui.lib_rest_done: You step away from the terminal. Cognitive contamination fell by {n} points.
ui.lib_random_none: Nothing unread is left at your clearance level.
ui.lib_hint_random: HINT: nothing links your files to anything new. Try {a}, one of the most-read files at your level.
lib_about_lines: A SCiPNET terminal for reading the real SCP Wiki.
Every article is real content from the SCP Wiki (scp-wiki.wikidot.com), licensed CC BY-SA 3.0, shown with its author and source link.
Only the terminal is added: clearance by object class, ranks, cognitive contamination, and findings (the real links between articles).
SCP Foundation content belongs to its authors and the SCP Wiki community.

contamination.30:
>> For a moment a line you did not type was on the screen, and then was
   not. Cognitive contamination: 30%
contamination.50:
>> You stopped in the middle of a paragraph and went back to the start.
   It was the same paragraph. Something in it was not the same.
   Cognitive contamination: 50%
contamination.70:
>> To recall your own name you thought, for a second, about your
   personnel file. Cognitive contamination: 70% -- CRITICAL
contamination.85:
>> The archive is looking at you now. You would like to write that down
   as a figure of speech and you find that you cannot.
   Cognitive contamination: 85% -- NEAR THRESHOLD
